question: Which MS-ADS program options are visa-eligible for international students?

pipeline_flatrag.answer:
Based on the available program materials, the full-time, In-Person 1-Year 12-Course Program and the 2-Year Thesis Track 18-Course Program are visa-eligible for international students [1]. The Online Program is not eligible for visa sponsorship [2].

Sources:
1. [Faqs | International Students > Which Master's in Applied Data Science provides students with visas?](https://datascience.uchicago.edu/education/masters-programs/ms-in-applied-data-science/faqs/)
2. [Faqs | Online Program > Do I need to be a US citizen or permanent resident to apply to Master's in Applied Data Science Online Program?](https://datascience.uchicago.edu/education/masters-programs/ms-in-applied-data-science/faqs/)

[N6] International Students — path: FAQs > International Students
  [N6.1] Accordion
    [E1] (structure summary) This accordion contains: Which Master's in Applied Data Science provides students with visas?; What is the total cost of tuition for the Master's in Applied Data Science program?; Is the Master's in Applied Data Science an approved OPT/STEM program?; Does the Master's in Applied Data Science program offer Curricular Practical Training (CPT)?; I have worked in the U.S. for more than two years. Does that mean that I am exempt from the TOEFL/IELTS requirement?
    [N6.1.1] Which Master's in Applied Data Science provides students with visas?
      [E2] The full-time, In-Person 1-Year 12-Course Program & 2-Year Thesis Track 18-Course Program are visa eligible.
    [N6.1.2] Is the Master's in Applied Data Science an approved OPT/STEM program?
      [E3] Yes, the full-time, In-Person Master’s in Applied Data Science program is listed as a STEM-designated degree by the U.S. Department of Homeland Security for the purposes of the STEM OPT extension, allowing eligible students to apply. However, approval of STEM OPT is at the discretion of U.S. Citizenship & Immigration Services.
    [N6.1.3] I have worked in the U.S. for more than two years. Does that mean that I am exempt from the TOEFL/IELTS requirement?
      [E4] Please refer to the English Language Proficiency guidelines.

[N7] Online Program — path: FAQs > Online Program
  [N7.1] Accordion
    [E5] (structure summary) This accordion contains: If I am a student in the In-Person Master's in Applied Data Science Program, may I take courses in the Online Program? Conversely, if I am a student in the Online Program, may I take courses in the In-Person program?; Do I need to be a US citizen or permanent resident to apply to Master's in Applied Data Science Online Program?; How will enrolling in Master's in Applied Data Science Online Program impact my schedule? Are classes held synchronously, asynchronously, or both?; Will enrolling in Master's in Applied Data Science Online Program give me the opportunity to network with on-campus students, faculty/instructors, and advisors?; What value do employers place on the Master's in Applied Data Science Online degree?; Is the Master's in Applied Data Science Online program equally academically rigorous as the In-Person program?; Will my diploma indicate I
    [E6] (structure summary) equally academically rigorous as the In-Person program?; Will my diploma indicate I completed the Master's in Applied Data Science Program Online?
    [N7.1.1] If I am a student in the In-Person Master's in Applied Data Science Program, may I take courses in the Online Program? Conversely, if I am a student in the Online Program, may I take courses in the In-Person program?
      [E7] Currently, students may only take Master’s in Applied Data Science courses in the modality in which they are officially enrolled.
    [N7.1.2] Do I need to be a US citizen or permanent resident to apply to Master's in Applied Data Science Online Program?
      [E8] No, students do not have to be US citizen or resident to partake in the Online Program . Please note that the Online Program is not eligible for visa sponsorship.
    [N7.1.3] How will enrolling in Master's in Applied Data Science Online Program impact my schedule? Are classes held synchronously, asynchronously, or both?
      [E9] Classes generally take place on evenings and weekends in order to allow our students and instructors to maintain their professional schedules. The Master’s in Applied Data Science Online Program is both synchronous and asynchronous. The same as our In-Person program, students are required to participate in weekly, live meetings with their instructors and peers, complete readings and coursework, and engage in discussion.
    [N7.1.4] Will enrolling in Master's in Applied Data Science Online Program give me the opportunity to network with on-campus students, faculty/instructors, and advisors?
      [E10] Yes. All Master’s in Applied Data Science Online Program students are invited to an annual ‘ Immersion Weekend ’ where attendees have opportunities to network and participate in other activities. On a rolling basis, our Career Services team will advertise additional opportunities to connect with employers and peers (e.g., virtual career fairs, virtual career advising/coaching appointments, and more).
    [N7.1.5] What value do employers place on the Master's in Applied Data Science Online degree?
      [E11] The value employers place on the Master’s in Applied Data Science degree is significant. As they hire Data Scientist, Data Engineers, and Data Analysts from the University of Chicago the expectations for technical competence, communication and influence skills, and exposure to advanced Data Science evolving technologies is high. The skills learned in the program translate directly into practice due to the program’s balance between theory and rigorous application experience developed in coursework and the Capstone project work delivered across the curriculum.
    [N7.1.6] Is the Master's in Applied Data Science Online program equally academically rigorous as the In-Person program?
      [E12] Yes. The Online Program curriculum is overseen by the same faculty curriculum committee as the In-Person program. Both programs are jointly reviewed and are held to the same high standards. Additionally, both programs are granted by the University of Chicago Physical Sciences Division .
    [N7.1.7] Will my diploma indicate I completed the Master's in Applied Data Science Program Online?
      [E13] No, your diploma will not include ‘Online’ in the name of your degree.

[N2] Master’s in Applied Data Science FAQs — path: FAQs > Master’s in Applied Data Science FAQs
  [E14] Learn more about what makes our program unique.
David Uminsky, PhD – UChicago Data Science Institute, Executive Director
